note: Signal Strength is NOT Fit Score. Fit Score is owned by crm-core's scoring lane and must never be written from this repo. Signal Strength is the FALLBACK triage gate used when crm-core's real scorer is unreachable; when it is reachable, predicted fit governs.
reweightedBecause: crm-core's fit weights put 55 of 100 points on NYC heads + NYC jobs, and only 10 on funding. v1 of this file weighted funding at 25 and treated it as a fit signal. It is a timing signal. Weights below now track the real model.

nyc_headcount_visible.meaning: A source states the size of the company's New York team.
nyc_headcount_visible.note: Maps to the highest-weighted fit component (NYC Heads, 30 pts). The single best thing research can find.

hiring_surge.meaning: Material number of open roles located in NYC.

nyc_office_opening.meaning: Company states it is opening, expanding, or relocating to a New York office.

outgrown_space.meaning: Explicit statement that current space is too small.
examples: leaving WeWork for our own space
moved three times in two years

workplace_hire.meaning: Hired a Head of Workplace / Facilities / Office Manager / Head of Ops. Someone whose job is the office.
workplace_hire.note: From sales-nav §10.9 — a better demand tell than headcount alone.

lease_signal.meaning: Direct lease chatter — expiring lease, subleasing, space listed.
lease_signal.note: Rare but the highest-intent signal when it appears.

headcount_growth.meaning: Headcount climbing — doubled, tripled, or a stated milestone (20/50/100).

rto_mandate.meaning: Announced return-to-office, in-person, or hybrid policy change.

arr_valuation_growth.meaning: Sharp ARR growth, a new valuation, or unicorn status.
arr_valuation_growth.note: Growth proxy when headcount isn't stated. Still not a fit signal on its own.

funding_round.meaning: Priced round announced. Tells you WHEN a company will grow, not whether it is a good lead.
funding_round.note: Deliberately down-weighted from v1's 25. Funding is 10 of 100 in the real fit model.

new_nyc_entity.meaning: New NY entity registration or NYC address first appearing.

thresholds.note: Fallback gate only — used when crm-core's scorer is unreachable. See config/research.json → gate.
